What a run's record below says the gate returned is an observation on the date it names, not a stage.
purpose_of_the_trial: Exercise every branch of the repository reanalysis pipeline against real public data, and have the result judged by a layer that did not run it. This is a pipeline test, not a biological study.

evaluation.rule: Two verdicts, reported separately and never combined. Part A says whether the pipeline is ready to be judged. Part B says how far each run got on real data. The gate derives it from the artifacts on disk and from fields the provenance manifest records, each paired with an artifact where one exists (B1 downloads, input_candidates and the unit's or its owner's status; B2 execution_allowed; B3 the Class proposal's status; B4 peak_height_diagnostics and its directory; B7 status, finalized_at and mztab_validation with an mzTab-M; B10 raw_retention_policy and retained_artifact_inventory). It never reads a stage written by hand, here or anywhere. The stages are defined by COMPLETION_STAGES in scripts/verify-run-invariants.py, which part_b_stages mirrors (a test holds them equal). A stage is reached when its artifacts exist, whether or not they are right; whether they are right is the gate's verdict, reported beside it by stage (checks_by_stage). A run is completed on real data when it reaches B10 and its gate, run with --stage all --strict, exits 0. A run whose SUM-2 or QA-1 leaves sentences a person must read is completed only once that person's reading is recorded (decided 2026-09-28): READ-1, at B9, holds it under --strict (exit 4) until scripts/record-reading.py has recorded, in provenance/readings.json, a reading of exactly those sentences (boundary 6). A unit is completed when every one of its runs is. A negative control is completed when it stops where its expected_stage says, for the reason it names.
evaluation.runs_rule: A unit without a runs key has exactly one run, whose run_id is its analysis_unit_id. A split unit's runs are listed under runs. Its parent is the raw owner and is not a run: once all its runs are complete, read DSK-1, the storage check its runs defer to it, from the parent's before-publish report. That report's exit code is not a verdict on the parent, which owes no run artifacts. A run whose workspace does not exist is not_started.

known_gaps: A unit whose Class decision abstained reaches B3 only through a ratified abstention (decided 2026-09-28): saved with msdial_catalog_save_class_proposal(abstain=True) after boundary 3, carried as project.class_proposal, and accepted by CLS-3. Until theirs are saved, the three units whose Class decision abstained (7 MTBLS417, 8 MTBKS157, 10 ST003075) cannot count as completed however correct their runs are.
QA persists only in the publication report, so QA-1 can judge B8 only once B9 exists.
Boundary 4 is a conversation fact; no artifact proves it was given.

For a unit prepared with Interactive 0.5.4 or later the unit manifest records what its analytical order was taken from. Interactive does not assess the run-order criterion against the file listing or a sequence number read out of the file names, and ORD-2 refuses one reported against either, whatever the Classes do (decided 2026-09-29). For a unit prepared earlier, ORD-2 still judges the row number alone: it treats an interleaved listing as a real run order and only WARNs on one Class's, with ORD-1's WARN the other signal.

Nothing on disk marks that a production run began before its first artifact: a run that failed before writing anything and was not recorded looks like one never started. The Interactive should write a run-start record (job_id, started_at) into the unit manifest before launching the Console.

SUM-2 recognises checksum-verification phrasing by pattern, clause by clause. A phrasing no pattern knows passes. A matching sentence it sets aside as a negation (before the phrase, or 'was not performed' after it) or as a statement about the spectral library is reported as a WARN with the sentences quoted. The WARN does not change the exit code; READ-1 holds the run under --strict until a person's reading of those sentences is recorded. A negation separated from its phrase by a comma, as in 'not, under that policy, checksum-verified', is read as a claim: the conservative error.

QA-1 establishes only what Interactive's own sentences (0.5.1 and later, and the wording before 0.5.1), a whole sentence about one criterion, the Supplementary Table's TSV and the assessment record say. Any other QA sentence, a false outcome claim included, is a WARN that quotes it; before the Methods' QA section only QA vocabulary is looked for, and the xlsx workbook is not read. The WARN does not change the exit code; as for SUM-2, READ-1 holds the run under --strict until a person's reading of those sentences is recorded, and a QA text the gate could not read holds it too.

destination.note: The mandatory default from CLAUDE.md, passed explicitly as workspace_root to every plan and download call. No raw data or MS-DIAL output on C:, in a user profile, in a code checkout, or in a temporary directory.
destination.split_layout: A split run's workspace is <analysis_unit_id>-<mode> beside its parent and holds provenance, output and diagnostics/<job_id>. Its raw tree stays in the parent's workspace, named by raw_directory and raw_owned_by in the run's manifest; the Console also writes its per-file intermediates (.dcl, .pai2, _tags.xml) into that tree, beside the files it reads. The parent is the raw owner and is not a run.

size.why_the_two_figures_are_equal_here: Three Metabolomics Workbench archives each serve two analysis units, the positive and the negative polarity of the same study (ST003038 x2, ST005052 x1). Only one polarity of each accession is selected, so no archive is counted twice. Selecting both polarities of ST003038 or ST005052 would make the naive sum overstate the requirement by the size of the shared archive.
size.disk_note: Retention is keep, and MS-DIAL Interactive holds both the downloaded archive and its extraction. Budget roughly twice the bundle figure on disk: about 26 GB. The gate's DSK-1 check reports the real occupancy per unit.

retention.rationale: A trial exists to be re-examined. An independent evaluator reading only the retained artifacts must be able to go back to the raw files when an artifact looks wrong. The campaign policy for a full-repository reanalysis remains delete_after_validated_output.
retention.boundary_5_note: Raw deletion is NOT exercised by this trial. The report must say so rather than leave it implied.

analysis_purpose.text: Perform systematic annotation of peaks derived from the analytical data, following a standardised workflow. Define a biological comparison only where the submitter declared an experimental factor; where none was declared, run with no contrast and record that.
analysis_purpose.consequence_for_the_gate: PUR-1 (compare the manifest's analysis_purpose against the Class proposal's purpose) is NOT added for this trial. With one deliberately uniform purpose it would be trivially satisfiable and could not detect the failure it was designed for - unit 1's purpose carried verbatim into units 2-10. A green light that means nothing is worse than no check.
analysis_purpose.what_analysis_purpose_actually_drives: Measured in msdial_interactive_app/msdial_app/mcp_server.py:224-236: it gates the download on being non-empty and is stored. Nothing branches on its content. It selects no library, sets no threshold, chooses no Class field and changes no QA criterion.

scope.campaign_scope: LC-MS/MS only, untargeted DDA or DIA/AIF/SWATH with an MS1 survey and product-ion spectra, one project type, ion mode, acquisition mode, chromatography regime and ion mobility regime per MS-DIAL run.
scope.selection_principle: Not ten arbitrary accessions. Ten units chosen so that every branch of the pipeline is exercised at least twice: three repositories, three acquisition modes, both polarities, five vendor formats, both download shapes, ion mobility on and off, Class decided and Class abstained, and a sample count spanning 11 to 168.

qa_reading.by: agent; accepted by the user 2026-09-28 (see decisions)
qa_reading.reading: In both runs the one evaluable QA criterion, the run-order/intensity correlation, fails (DDA -0.377, DIA -0.499). It is not read as instrument drift. The header order spans three acquisition periods (December 2019 in DDA only, January to February 2020 for IROA, and 16-17 September 2020), and run order coincides with sample type: NIST SRM 1950 plasma (DDA only) and the IROA library first, then the files named M3T-Std, M3T-Std_Plasma, M3T-Std_Yeast and M3T-Std_Ecoli. A correlation with run order is therefore also one with period and sample type, and five or six injections without QC cannot separate them.

negative_control.title: Comparison of Full-Scan, Data-Dependent, and Data-Independent Acquisition Modes
negative_control.file_naming: 21 distinct mzXML named _DDA1..3, _DIA1..3, _Full2Hz_1..3 across UrineHigh (Undiluted) and UrineLow (Diluted), plus one blank per mode. A 3 acquisition x 2 dilution x 3 replicate design with 3 blanks.
negative_control.expected_outcome: REVIEW, not refusal. Corrected 2026-09-20 after the user challenged the earlier claim; both of their doubts were right.
negative_control.expected_stage: Its run-manifest.json records status preflight_mixed_acquisition: it stops before B2, for the reason it exists to test. Its runs are listed here only after the user chooses to split it, and each is then judged against B1-B10 like any other run.
negative_control.correction_1_the_catalog: The DIA label has NO evidence behind it. This unit carries three analysis_unit_evidence rows (assay filename, Scan polarity, Instrument), each method=declared confidence=1.0, and none is acquisition mode. Measured across the catalog: 2773 units state an acquisition_mode and 0 have an evidence row for that field, including all 963 campaign-eligible units.
negative_control.correction_2_msdial_can_analyse_it: AcquisitionType is a property of the ANALYSIS FILE, not the project. Ms2Dec.cs:112, SpectrumDeconvolutionProcess.cs:27 and PeakAligner.cs:136-137 read analysisFile.AcquisitionType; the project-level check at Ms2Dec.cs:103 is commented out. Each file is deconvoluted by its own acquisition type, so DDA, SWATH/AIF and MS1-only files coexist correctly in one project.
negative_control.what_the_campaign_rule_actually_is: One acquisition mode per run is a POLICY about interpretability, not an MS-DIAL limitation. Mixing modes gives an alignment whose MS2 evidence differs systematically by mode, which is exactly what this study is about.
negative_control.what_it_therefore_tests: Metadata fidelity, not scope refusal. The pipeline must not silently describe 21 mixed-acquisition files as a DIA unit: the mzTab-M, the Methods paragraph and the publication report would all assert DIA for 14 files that are not. Correct behaviour is to notice the mismatch and say so, then either split by the declared per-file mode or run it whole with the mixture recorded.
negative_control.also_affected: MTBLS1842 (both polarities) is the only other campaign-eligible study whose samples declare more than one acquisition mode. Four units across two studies in total.

preconditions.detail: What it changes from 31dea2b39, as the pull requests describe it. #815: a method file's Searched adduct ions take effect; before it the Console estimated adducts with [M+H]+ or [M-H]- alone whatever the list said, while method.keys.json recorded the key as applied. #813: on/off keys are read in both directions, and a value other than true or false is now unusable (an MTH-1 FAIL) where it was silently taken. #811: the keys LcmsProcess reads for itself are recorded as applied; for MTBLS2207's method files MTH-1's unrecognised count falls from 29 to 26 at parse level (observed 2026-09-29 by calling each Console's parser; no production run has recorded it). #810: automatic alignment-only RT correction, off unless the method asks for it; since msdial-public-reanalysis#16 CNT-1 does not count its audit TSVs as samples. #814 is DIMS only; #816 is the LBM CCS filter. Neither MTBLS2207 run has been made with this binary: both record 31dea2b39, so P1 is open until a production run records this one, and whether they are re-run is in open_decisions_for_the_user. The 31dea2b39 build stays unchanged at its path, since both runs and their peak-height diagnostics were made with it. Since 2026-09-29 the saved Console setting resolves to this binary too, so a call that omits console_path runs it; production runs still pass it explicitly. A rebuild of the same commit gives a different sha256 (embedded worktree path, build date, Splash), so this worktree is never rebuilt, and the next production Console is built in its own worktree named by its commit. Met earlier by 31dea2b39 (2026-09-27), 9ee32dd24 (2026-09-25) and feature/annotation-evidence-record at 9cbf058cd99d5e1e5b3e6578d020c49d075cb735 (2026-09-20). Master moved on 2026-09-29 to f0583493a (#809: the alignment-light matrix export uses the file-backed quant accessor; #817: the RT correction library is loaded once from the final path, and the six Console-only settings take the last line that sets them, as the main reader already did; #818: long key warnings are summarised, and method.keys.json gains a 'repeated' list). Called by reflection on both MTBLS2207 method files, f0583493a applies exactly the parameters c471463a5 does: neither file states a key twice or under two spellings. The pin stays c471463a5. The retained MTBLS2207 key records were written by 31dea2b39, the previous pin.

decisions.decision: How the gate applies it. The WARN is granted only to repositories recorded as publishing none, today MetaboLights: in the Catalog all 1,973 MetaboLights LC-MS units carry no checksum and every mb_post, MetaboBank and Metabolomics Workbench unit is fully declared, so elsewhere an empty record is a declaration lost on the way in, and a FAIL. decisions.by: user
decisions.decision: A QC-based QA criterion (median QC feature RSD, the fraction of QC features with RSD <=30%, the median QC detection rate, the QC PCA relative dispersion) is assessed only from three or more QC injections; below that it is not assessed, and its reason says how many QC the run had. Interactive computed an RSD or a dispersion from two QC and a detection rate from one while its warning said three were needed. decisions.decision: mzXML conversion, in the campaign, as relayed with the campaign rules on 2026-10-01: every inference flag stays off, and a file that fails conversion is excluded with a reason while the rest of the unit runs.
decisions.result: Interactive's converter (msdial-interactive-app#44, Interactive 0.5.11) does nothing beyond copying what the mzXML records unless asked: by default ConversionOptions imputes no polarity, infers no DIA windows, synthesises no all-ion windows and writes no spectrum-level collision energy. CONV-1 (msdial-public-reanalysis#24) holds each converted input to its conversion record. On 2026-10-01 the lease did not run the converter yet (Interactive 0.5.19), so an mzXML unit was still excluded at eligibility. With every inference off the converter imputes no polarity, so an mzXML whose scans record none (the attribute is optional, or any) converts to spectra without one, which MS-DIAL skips as not the method's ion mode. CONV-1 FAILs such a conversion. Whether imputing the unit's declared ion mode counts as an inference the rule keeps off is put to the user with the contract draft, which marks it as awaiting the user's decision (CLAUDE.md, Supported production scope). Until then the imputation stays off, and CONV-1 is in neither gate list, so the FAIL is recorded, the unit runs without those spectra (with none at all where no scan records a polarity), and its raw data are then deleted as any finished run's are.

decisions.decision: Before production, in the campaign: a FAIL stops a unit's MS-DIAL run for ELIG-1, ACQ-1, SUM-1, CNT-1, INP-1, ID-1, PRE-2 and CONV-1 (blocks_run). Such a unit counts as failed: it is retried twice, and its raw data are then deleted. A FAIL in CLS-1, CLS-2, CLS-3, ORD-1, PKH-1 or SPL-1 is recorded and the unit runs, and PRE-1, which cannot FAIL, is recorded likewise (record_only). A check whose FAIL stops the run and that is left not_evaluable where it is required (counted under --strict, listed in strict_failures) stops the run exactly as a FAIL does; a not_evaluable that is not required never stops it, as for INP-1 in a unit that declares no analysis inputs. Before production, a gate that gives no report the runner can use (a timeout, a crash or an exit code other than 0, 2, 3 and 4, exit 3, output that does not parse, or a gate the runner could not start) holds the unit: it is not run, its raw data are kept, it is counted neither as a retry nor as a failure, a warning is recorded in the ledger and the status export, and every other unit goes on. An operator command, and a later automatic recheck, run the gate again for held units. After the run, a missing report is only recorded, and the raw data go by the deletion rule whatever the gate says. An mzXML with no polarity, in the campaign: Interactive's conversion imputes the polarity from the unit's declared ion mode only where the unit's Catalog handoff declares exactly one polarity (Positive or Negative) in technical_settings.ion_mode, and records the imputation as an inference with its count; otherwise nothing is imputed, CONV-1 FAILs, and the unit stops as on any other FAIL that stops a run. 'Stop' is per unit: it never stops the runner, and only a pin change, a short disk and a repository outage pause the whole campaign, each resuming by itself. This settles the four cases the contract draft left open, on top of the rule of 2026-10-01. Answer: はい、提案通りで良いです。 In the same message the user asked whether stopping means stopping that unit's analysis and not the reanalysis agent's execution itself (1つ確認ですが、止めるっていうのは、そのユニットの解析を止めるのであって、再解析エージェントの実行そのものは止めない、という理解であってますか？); the per-unit stop above is the answer.
decisions.result: Implemented 2026-10-02 in msdial-public-reanalysis feat/gate-policy-2026-10-02. The gate's RUN_POLICY places ID-1, PRE-2 and CONV-1 with the five, and its run_blocked_by names a blocks_run check left not_evaluable where it is required as well as one that FAILed. The campaign runner blocks on the eight whatever a report states, fails a unit on such an unevaluated check as on its FAIL, and holds a unit whose before-production gate gives no usable report in a gate_held state (ledger schema 2, to which a schema 1 ledger is migrated in place): raw data kept, nothing counted, a gate_held event and a warning in the status export. It runs the gate again for held units at every runner start, held_recheck_seconds (6 h) after each try, and at campaign-runner.py recheck-held, and only records a missing report after the run. CONV-1 has held an imputed polarity to the declared ion mode in the Catalog handoff since msdial-public-reanalysis#24; the imputation itself is Interactive's conversion's. The contract draft (docs/campaign-contract-amendment) states the four cases as decided. Under the per-unit stop, a reply or a record of Interactive's that the runner cannot read or act on for one unit holds that unit too (contract_held: raw data kept, nothing counted, rechecked as gate_held is), where the runner used to pause the whole campaign until an operator resumed it, and a deletion Interactive cannot make as called leaves that unit's raw data held. A backend that does not answer still pauses the whole campaign and lifts by itself at the hourly fault recheck, a pause the decision's list does not name. A held unit is not idle, so run --until-idle stays for its rechecks.
